column1: # Custom partition table - the built-in "single app (large)" preset doesn't
# scale to this board's 16MB flash (it's a small fixed size regardless of
# pulled in) already overflows it. 4MB for the app leaves comfortable
# headroom for growth; photos live on the SD card
# need for a large data partition here. See sdkconfig.defaults'
# Placeholder USB-MSC backing store - a tiny wear-levelled FAT partition the
# USB port exposes as a drive at boot
# the real SD card handed over (see app_usb.c). Not used for anything else.
